image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of dark, decaying leaf litter. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow-orange markings along its back and head. Its skin appears wet and textured. The head is visible on the left, showing a small eye and parotoid gland area, while the body curves towards the right, ending in a tail that blends slightly with the background leaves.
